source.section: PDF p.45-46 Form 39R instructions Line 8e Part Two (closed list; FERS and PERSI Base Plan don't qualify); PDF p.10 Line 12a; PDF p.11 worksheet line 5 ('born before January 2, 1961'); Form 40 lines 7-11, 12a, 15-20, 26 (PDF p.29-30); instructions PDF p.10-11 Standard Deduction Worksheet lines 1-6 and Line 20 worksheet lines 1-5; PDF p.13-14 Line 43 and Food Tax Credit Worksheet; PDF p.12 Line 31; record brackets and base.deductions cites

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = ID government pension (person 0) 36,000.00 + interest 2,000.00 = 38,000.00. Federal taxable income = 38,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction - 1 x 2,000.00 age 65 additional = 20,250.00 (the federal senior deduction is ignored). Form 40 (filing status single): line 7 federal AGI 38,000.00. Line 8 additions 0.00; line 9 = 38,000.00 + 0.00 = 38,000.00. Form 39R Part B line 7 Social Security and railroad benefits included in federal income = 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00. Line 8: the inputs show an Idaho public pension and not the fund. A PERSI Base Plan pension doesn't qualify (PDF p.46), so the return matches the projection; the Firefighters Retirement Fund or a closed city police fund would qualify on the return, and the projection taxes those in full too (approximations). Line 8e 0.00; line 8f 0.00. Line 18 health insurance premiums: none in the inputs, 0.00. Line 24 total subtractions = 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00. Form 40 line 10 0.00; line 11 total adjusted income = 38,000.00 - 0.00 = 38,000.00. Line 12a boxes checked 1. Standard Deduction Worksheet: line 1 15,750.00; line 4 15,750.00; line 5 1 x 2,000.00 = 2,000.00; line 6 17,750.00. Line 15 0.00 (no Schedule A); line 16 17,750.00. Line 17 = 38,000.00 - 17,750.00 = 20,250.00. Line 18 federal Form 1040 lines 13a and 13b taken as 0.00; line 19 Idaho taxable income 20,250.00. Line 20 worksheet: line 1 20,250.00; line 2 4,811.00; line 3 = 15,439.00; line 4 at 5.3%; line 5 tax = 15,439.00 x 5.3% = 818.267, to the cent 818.27 (the return rounds to whole dollars, PDF p.8, and shows 818; expected keeps the formula). Lines 21-24 credits 0.00; line 25 0.00; line 26 818.27. Food Tax Credit Worksheet (Form 40 line 43): 1 x 155.00 = 155.00. State income tax = 818.27 - 155.00 = 663.27. Line 31 Permanent Building Fund tax 10.00 is on the return but the projection does not charge it (approximations). Line 18 would take any federal Schedule 1-A amount, the senior deduction included; it is ignored here and the projection does not subtract it (approximations).
accepted_approximations: A pension from CSRS (eligibility before 1984), FSRDS, the PERSI Firefighters Retirement Fund or a closed Idaho city police fund is taxed in full; the deduction is left out because the same inputs describe FERS and PERSI Base Plan pensions, which do not qualify.
The Permanent Building Fund tax of 10 a return (Form 40 line 31) is not charged.
The federal Schedule 1-A and qualified business income deductions are not subtracted (Form 40 line 18).
